lines.en: My mind is somehow put at ease despite the incessant barrage of chaos that has been hurled at it after opening a door I thought was normal.
lines.zh: 尽管在推开那扇我以为很普通的门之后，混乱就不停地朝我砸来，我的心却莫名其妙地安定了下来。

lines.en: I still don’t understand why I’m here, but at least the scent of waterlogged wood and the feeling of a thousand bug bites has ceased to be.
lines.zh: 我还是不明白自己为什么在这儿，但至少那股泡烂木头的气味和成千上万次虫咬的感觉都停止了。

lines.en: I sit on the ground and the grass irritates my skin due to an allergy, but it’s a discomfort that I am glad to have as it means I’m able to rest for a few seconds.
lines.zh: 我坐在地上，草因为过敏刺得我皮肤发痒，但这种不适我很乐意承受，因为这意味着我能休息几秒钟。

lines.en: When I look down, I notice what I believe to be thick vines wrapping around my ankles and attempting to pull me under.
